description:
Welcome to Paws & Paths, the cozy logic puzzle game where classic Nonogram mechanics meet heartwarming animal rescue journeys!

Instead of revealing static abstract pixel art, every row and column clue you solve connects whimsical tracks and cobblestone paths to guide sweet animal companions to their goals — help the curious kitten reach its lost ball of yarn and explore peaceful landscapes along the way.

WHY YOU’LL LOVE PAWS & PATHS:

• ZERO STRESS & COZY VIBES: No ticking timers, no lost hearts, no penalties. Take your time, relax, and solve at your own pace.

• 100% PURE DEDUCTION: Every single puzzle is mathematically guaranteed to be solvable through clear logic. Zero guessing required.

• CHARMING WINDING MAP: Advance through an illustrated journey map, earning stars and guiding your mascot token across scenic chapters.

• SENSORY DELIGHT: Gentle tactile haptics, pastel aesthetics, and adorable victory celebrations that bring instant warmth to your day.

• FRIENDLY HINTS: Stuck on a tricky intersection? Friendly hints are always ready to illuminate the way forward.

Unwind with a cup of tea and cozy up with Paws & Paths today!
promotionalText: Connect whimsical tracks, guide adorable animal friends to their goals, and relax with 100% deductive, stress-free cozy puzzles.
